get.description: Submit a chemical for property prediction calculations. Provide either SMILES or CAS number. Results include LogKow, melting/boiling points, vapor pressure, water solubility, Henry's Law constant, biodegradation rates, bioconcentration factors, atmospheric half-life, hydrolysis, fugacity model, sewage treatment model, dermal permeability, and ECOSAR aquatic toxicity predictions.

parameters.description: SMILES notation of the chemical. Either smiles or cas is required.
parameters.name: smiles

parameters.description: CAS registry number. Either smiles or cas is required.
parameters.name: cas

parameters.description: Comma-separated list of modules to run. If not specified, all modules are run. Valid values: logKow, mpbpvp, waterSolubilityFromLogKow, waterSolubilityFromWaterNt, henrysLawConstant, logKoa, logKoc, biodegradationRate, hydrocarbonBiodegradationRate, bioconcentration, aerosolAdsorptionFraction, atmosphericHalfLife, hydrolysis, waterVolatilization, sewageTreatmentModel, fugacityModel, dermalPermeability, ecosar, aimanalogs
